cases.name: zero
cases.note: every axis empty, accept — the minimal signed message

cases.name: zero_reject
cases.note: every axis empty, reject — differs from accept in the final byte alone

cases.name: spec
cases.note: the reference position; the transport ids (blockID, parentID) do not appear in the message

cases.name: outer_moved
cases.note: the reference position with both transport ids changed — the message is unchanged

cases.name: degrade
cases.note: canonical slots unset: the transport ids are bound under them

cases.name: degrade_explicit
cases.note: the same position with canonical == outer stated outright — identical bytes

cases.name: max
cases.note: every field at its maximum width — catches a truncated or byte-swapped integer

layout: per vote: nodeID:20 accept:1 sigLen:4 sig:sigLen

cases.name: nova_single
cases.note: one signer at the local-execution rung — the smallest well-formed certificate

cases.name: quasar_sorted
cases.note: votes handed in descending order; the wire carries them ascending by node id

cases.name: empty_signature
cases.note: a zero-length signature — the length prefix stands alone

weighted.note: equal stake, five validators — collapses to ⌊2n/3⌋+1
equal stake, twenty-one validators — 15, not 14: 14/21 does not strictly exceed ⅔
one validator holds most of the stake
two heavy validators cannot reach ⅔ alone
a dust registration must not move the gate
empty set — no stake model, fail closed
all weights zero — no stake model, fail closed

threshold.stakeNote: a quorum must STRICTLY EXCEED its floor. Quasar (export) needs voted > twoThirds; Nova (local execution) needs voted > half. Equality is not a quorum.
threshold.countNote: novaSignerFloor is the count guard the stake predicate cannot give — a lone holder of a stake majority must not self-ignite. equalStakeQuasar is the ⅔ count for a uniform set.

fpc.seedNote: seed = sha256(be64(epoch) || chainID || prevBlockHash). Every input is bound, and prevBlockHash is unknown until the previous epoch finalizes, so θ cannot be steered by choosing an input before the epoch opens.

seeds.note: epoch zero, no chain, no parent — every input at its floor
first epoch of a chain, genesis has no previous block
the chain moves the seed — two chains at one epoch must not share θ
the previous block moves the seed — this is what makes it unpredictable
a different previous block, everything else held
full width: a 32-byte chain id and a 32-byte parent hash
the top of the epoch range — every byte of the big-endian width is set

fpc.thetaNote: θ(phase) = θ_min + be64(sha256(seed || be64(phase))[:8])/(2^64-1) · (θ_max − θ_min), and α = ⌈θ·k⌉ is the vote count a round accepts on. thetaMin, thetaMax and theta are exact IEEE-754 bits in big-endian hex: α is a ceiling, so the last bit of θ is load-bearing.
